# railway_access_group (Resource)

Railway workspace access group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_access_group" "example" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name         = "example"
  role         = "VIEWER"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the access group.
- `role` (String) Role granted to the members of the access group. One of `ADMIN`, `MEMBER` or `VIEWER`.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the access group belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the access group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env sh

# Access groups can be imported using `workspace_id:access_group_id`.
terraform import railway_access_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
